requirements.name: origin-convention
requirements.message:
The board root MUST declare `pcba:board:originConvention` — how the board's zero was chosen:
`cad_bbox_lower_left`, `fiducial_f1`, `mounting_hole`, `datum_explicit`, or `unspecified`. When
it is `datum_explicit`, `pcba:board:originPointMm` MUST state where the datum is.
`pcba:board:originLabel` SHOULD name the datum feature.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, section 11.

requirements.name: registries
requirements.message:
The board SHOULD expose a component registry: a `Registries` scope carrying
`rel pcba:board:members` that targets **every placed component on the board, all mount
classes**, so a consumer can enumerate parts without a full stage traversal. The registry is
an **index, not a source of truth**.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, section 3.

requirements.name: packaging-relative
requirements.message:
All `references` and `payloads` MUST use **relative** asset paths and nothing may point outside
the package. The board is **one asset, placed — never duplicated**: a panel references the board
once per position, and every repeated component references a shared prototype with
`instanceable = true`.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, section 4.

requirements.name: role-material
requirements.message:
Where a mesh's `pcba:mesh:role` determines its material class, the surface's material
MUST agree with that class. A copper-role surface bound to a solder-mask material (or
vice versa) is a defect: the role and the appearance disagree about what the surface
physically is.

requirements.name: mesh-role
requirements.message:
Every `Mesh` on the board MUST carry `pcba:mesh:role`, a token from the contract vocabulary that
names what the geometry *is*. The role is **authoritative** — a prim name may supplement it but
must never replace it.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, section 9.

requirements.name: stage-layout
requirements.message:
The board body MUST be present as a `Mesh` with `pcba:mesh:role = "board_substrate"`. Beyond
that, the contract describes a **desirable** stage shape — layers grouped by side, components,
copper, paste, holes, registries — but does not mandate it: an exporter that satisfies every
requirement with a different arrangement is conformant. Discovery is by role and attribute,
never by prim name.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, section 3.

requirements.name: material-binding
requirements.message:
Renderable meshes SHOULD carry a bound material so the board renders with its nominal
appearance. Board copper and mask geometry with production-accurate materials is required by
[BG.002](/capabilities/pcb_aoi/board_geometry/requirements/copper-mask-geometry); the bound
material's class must agree with the mesh role
([UO.017](/capabilities/pcb_aoi/usd_organization/requirements/role-material)).This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, sections 3, 5 and 9.

requirements.name: provenance
requirements.message:
The board root MUST carry `pcba:board:generatorVersion` and `pcba:board:contentHash`, both
non-empty strings. Together they record which exporter produced the board and give a content
hash of the referenced assets for integrity verification.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, section 11.

requirements.name: namespace
requirements.message:
Author PCB contract metadata under **`pcba:`**, with colon-delimited scopes and
lower-camelCase leaf names. Use ordinary custom USD attributes: no custom schema,
schema fallback, or plugin is required. Other domains' properties retain their
own namespaces.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, sections 1, 11 and 14.

requirements.name: stage-conventions
requirements.message:
The board stage MUST use `metersPerUnit = 0.001` (mm) and `upAxis = "Z"`, with **no
compensating root scale or rotation** on the default prim. The board lies in the **XY plane with
+Z as the board normal**: component height is +Z, `pcba:component:heightMm` is the Z extent, and
`pcba:component:nominalRotationDeg` is about Z.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, section 2.

requirements.name: board-root
requirements.message:
The board asset MUST have a single `defaultPrim` — its **name is free** — and MUST contain a
board-root prim discoverable by its `pcba:board:*` attributes, which carry the board-level
metadata (provenance, packaging, thickness, origin convention). The board root MAY be the
default prim but need not be.This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, sections 2, 3 and 11.

requirements.name: package-manifest
requirements.message:
A distributed board package MUST author `pcba:board:packageManifest` (an `asset`) on
the board-root prim — an inventory of the packaged files. This is the **package-file
BOM**, distinct from the CI.007 component manifest.

requirements.name: file-naming
requirements.message:
Asset file names SHOULD be clean ASCII with no spaces and no parentheses, so USD asset references
and downstream tooling resolve reliably across platforms. (Prim and attribute names must be valid
identifiers regardless.)This page follows PCBA to USD Input Contract **1.0.2**, section 2.
